articles.title: Modernizing Medical Standards for Non-Insulin Dependent Diabetes Mellitus Cases
articles.summary: FAA proposes to amend its regulations to allow applicants with non-insulin dependent diabetes mellitus to apply for airman medical certification that may be issued at the time of their medical examination instead of requiring Special Issuance review by FAA.
